profile.summary: Hello! I'm a Software Engineer at Meta, based in New York City. I'm passionate about analyzing systems, finding bottlenecks and thinking innovatively about complex problems. Why? As Engineers we have the tools and language to design, implement and improve the systems around us. The world is just the ultimate system, right?

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• ML development for Meta's recommendation systems, building foundational models to power the recommendation engine for Instagram Reels, and Instagram Stories, and Facebook Feed.
• Model serving infrastructure for state of the art recommendation paradigms (Generative Ranking, Listwise Recommendations).
• Agentic Research, developing a self-improving agent for MLE development.

projects.title: ScanIt
projects.description: A mobile application to enable University Professors to scan bubble sheets to auto-grade assignments. Automatically generates test scores for an entire class, reducing the amount of time and effort dedicated to grading assignments. Powered by OpenCV and Python on the backend and FlutterUI on the frontend.

projects.title: uAttend
projects.description:
Mobile and Web application for teachers and professors to automatically take class attendance. Prevents teachers from using outdated, error-prone attendance-taking techniques. 

Teachers start a session by generating a rotating QR code, which students scan on their mobile phone to verify their presence in class.
